name: Cancer Research High School Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah, with the American Cancer Society
what_you_do: A two week virtual program with lab lessons using a science kit sent to your home. You receive up to $500 in financial compensation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: HCI-RISE: Remote Immersive Science Experience
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A virtual two week summer program on cancer research and health careers, with workshops, career panels and small group work. You are paid up to $400.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Iowa 4-H Agricultural Ambassadors
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens mentor younger 4-H members and join career panels and tours of farm businesses. They learn to speak up for farming. They also lead a workshop for the whole state.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed July 7. The page does not name the year of that deadline; its schedule starts August 21, 2026. The page does not say when the next application opens.

name: Iowa 4-H Career Pathways Academy
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens look at jobs in farming, teaching, business, health, science and skilled trades. They visit colleges and work sites. They shadow local workers.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not stated on the page.

name: Iowa 4-H Reporters
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens report on county, regional and state 4-H events from June to August.
deadline_text: Members can apply in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). Events run June to August.

name: Iowa State 4-H Council
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Iowa 4-H members in grades 10 and 11 help plan the Iowa 4-H Youth Conference in Ames. They go to five weekend retreats in central Iowa. They also speak for 4-H with county councils and 4-H groups.
deadline_text: Applications open in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). No more than 60 interviews are held.

name: Iowa State Fair 4-H Volunteer, Youth Staff and Intern Jobs
org: Iowa 4-H, Iowa State University Extension and Outreach
what_you_do: Iowa only. 4-H members and alumni help run the 4-H Exhibits Building at the Iowa State Fair. They also help with speaking events and livestock and plant shows. They can work as volunteers, paid youth staff or summer interns.
deadline_text: 2026 volunteer form closed July 27. Summer 2027 intern positions open in December 2026. The page does not give 2027 fair dates.

name: Iowa 4-H
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens join county clubs and projects. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Council, State 4-H Recognition Day, State Project Area Awards and Youth Conference.
deadline_text: Join through 4-H Online. The page does not give a join date. State programs have their own application dates.

name: Iowa FFA
what_you_do: Iowa only. Students in farm and food classes build leadership and job skills. They do contests, work projects, conferences and the state convention.
deadline_text: The page does not state join dates. Dates for the state convention and officer selection are not on the home page.
